entities.summary: Regina Aleksandrovna Kulikova is a former professional Russian tennis player. Her highest WTA singles ranking is No. 65, which she reached in May 2010. Her career-high in doubles is 226, which she attained in May 2011. Her best result on the WTA Tour is her quarterfinal appearance at the 2010 Dubai Tennis Championships where she defeated Svetlana Kuznetsova. Her biggest victory at a Grand Slam tournament came at the 2011 Australian Open, where she defeated former semifinalist Daniela Hantuchová, in the first round.
